working: Photorespiration does occur in C3 plants, so (a) is false. During photorespiration O2 is consumed and CO2 is released, which is the reverse of (b), so (b) is false. RuBisCO acting as an oxygenase forms phosphoglycolate, so (c) is true. Photorespiration produces no ATP or NADPH, so (d) is true. The correct statements are (c) and (d), which is option 2.
